answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities. Each new identity pays a $30 sunk tax before it can work, recorded in sable ink on a public ledger. After ten honest jobs it enters a haven of full rewards; cheaters lose tax and access. To forge 1,000 identities costs $30,000 in taxes plus 10,000 fake jobs, far more than rewards they could drain. An honest agent pays $30 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
